test_cases.name: Basic ASCII Typing
test_cases.setup: Controller initialized in IDLE state; target is desktop stream.
test_cases.expected_result: All characters dispatched via SendInput with 0 errors; state returns to IDLE.

test_cases.name: Unicode Sequence-Level Input
test_cases.setup: Unicode decomposition into UTF-16 surrogate pairs, viramas, and variation selectors.
test_cases.action: Dispatched 105 Unicode characters (107 UTF-16 code units).
test_cases.expected_result: Surrogate pairs and Devanagari grapheme clusters correctly formatted and dispatched.
test_cases.actual_observation: Outcome: EXACT_MATCH, Exact Match: True, NFC Match: True.
test_cases.limitations: Full grapheme cluster rendering verified via UTF-16 surrogate pair decomposition.

test_cases.name: Modifier Key Reliability
test_cases.setup: Phased 4-step shortcut engine (Mod Down -> Key Down -> Key Up -> Mod Up).
test_cases.action: Executed 7 standard editing shortcuts including multi-modifier combinations.
test_cases.expected_result: Shortcuts execute cleanly and release all modifiers (0 stuck modifier keys).
test_cases.actual_observation: Shortcuts executed: 7, Orbit Keys Depressed Remaining: 0.

test_cases.name: Special Keys & Extended Keys
test_cases.setup: Virtual Key & Extended Key mapping for navigation and whitespace keys.
test_cases.action: Dispatched 13 individual special and extended keys.
test_cases.expected_result: All keys mapped to correct VK/extended flags; 0 stuck keys.

test_cases.name: Long Text Streaming
test_cases.expected_result: Full stream delivered without memory leak, deadlock, or dropped code units.
test_cases.limitations: Measured throughput across sustained multi-thousand character payload.

test_cases.name: Cancellation During Typing
test_cases.setup: Active typing stream (2,000 chars) interrupted mid-flight.
test_cases.expected_result: Worker halts immediately; state = PAUSED_BY_USER; 0 stuck keys; true latency measured.
test_cases.actual_observation: Halted after 12 chars. True Cancel Latency: 5152.5 µs.
test_cases.limitations: True cancellation latency measures T7 - T4 (signal request to complete worker exit).

test_cases.name: Interruption During Shortcut
test_cases.setup: ORBIT holding Ctrl+Shift when cancellation is issued mid-phase.
test_cases.action: Triggered sanitization while multiple modifiers were recorded in down-state.
test_cases.expected_result: All active ORBIT-owned modifiers cleanly released; state manager returns to 0 depressed keys.
test_cases.limitations: Guarantees 0 stuck modifier keys when aborted at any shortcut phase.

test_cases.name: Takeover Cancellation Interface Contract
test_cases.expected_result: Sink receives signal without direct source-code coupling to Prototype B.

test_cases.name: Focus Change & Target Loss
test_cases.setup: Target HWND set to non-existent or background window handle (0xDEAD).
test_cases.action: 4-step target verification checks foreground focus prior to first character dispatch.
test_cases.expected_result: Target mismatch detected; aborts before dispatch; state = SAFE_ABORT.
test_cases.limitations: Pre-dispatch and post-dispatch checks protect against window focus races.

test_cases.name: Exception Safety During Active Key Hold
test_cases.setup: Worker thread raises exception while modifiers are depressed.
test_cases.action: Exception caught by handler and executes guaranteed finally sanitization.
test_cases.expected_result: All ORBIT-owned modifiers cleanly released; 0 orphaned key states.
test_cases.actual_observation: Orbit Keys Remaining in State Manager: 0.
test_cases.limitations: Deterministic finally block guarantees modifier cleanup under all exception paths.

test_cases.name: Multi-Environment Compatibility
test_cases.setup: Multi-tier validation architecture (Tier 1 Widget, Tier 2 Native Notepad, Tier 3 Local Browser).
test_cases.action: Evaluated per-tier independence and readback strategies across all three tiers.
test_cases.expected_result: Independent reporting format maintained without cross-tier result extrapolation.
test_cases.actual_observation: Tier 1: PASS, Tier 2: PASS, Tier 3: PASS.
test_cases.evidence_classification: TIER 1 / TIER 2 LIVE; TIER 3 LOCAL HTML
test_cases.limitations: Tier 3 uses controlled local HTML harness (tier3_browser_test.html).

test_cases.name: Partial SendInput Injection Failure
test_cases.setup: SendInput returns k < cInputs during multi-event batch.
test_cases.action: State moves to PARTIAL_INJECTION_UNCERTAIN; triggers selective sanitization and SAFE_ABORT.
test_cases.expected_result: Only confidently tracked ORBIT keys sanitized; 0 stuck keys in tracker.
test_cases.limitations: Prevents partial injection from leaving undefined or dangling key states.

test_cases.name: Concurrent Keyboard Execution Attempt
test_cases.setup: MAX_ACTIVE_KEYBOARD_SESSIONS = 1 invariant enforced via REJECT_WITH_BUSY_ERROR policy.
test_cases.action: Attempted second typing request while primary session was marked active.
test_cases.expected_result: Second request immediately rejected with KeyboardSessionBusyError; primary session uncorrupted.
test_cases.limitations: Guarantees no two worker threads interleave SendInput calls.

test_cases.name: Shared Logical Key / Different Ownership
test_cases.setup: ORBIT holds Ctrl (ORBIT_INJECTED_TRACKED); User holds Shift (USER_PHYSICAL_OBSERVED).
test_cases.expected_result: ORBIT releases ONLY its own Ctrl key; User-owned Shift key is NEVER released.
test_cases.actual_observation: Sanitized: 1 ORBIT key, Untouched User Keys: 1.
test_cases.limitations: Documents merged user32 logical keystate boundary while enforcing non-destructive selective release.
